• Create a one-of-a-kind photo frame by personalising it with paints, decoupage papers, stencils, décor transfers, embellishments, mixed media textures, resin accents and more.
• Made from sturdy MDF with a smooth surface that is easy to paint, decorate and customise.
• Built-in magnet on the back allows convenient display on refrigerators, lockers, metal cabinets, office boards and other magnetic surfaces.
• Perfect for showcasing cherished photographs, artwork, notes and memorable keepsakes.
• An ideal DIY project for creating personalised gifts for birthdays, anniversaries, weddings, festivals and special occasions.
• Ready-to-decorate design encourages creativity, artistic expression and hands-on crafting.
• Suitable for use with paints, markers, glitter, stickers, embellishments and a variety of mixed media techniques.
• Great for hobby projects, school activities, art workshops, craft classes and family crafting sessions.
• Lightweight yet durable construction ensures long-lasting display and enjoyment.
• Perfect for hobbyists, students, artists and craft enthusiasts looking to create meaningful handmade keepsakes.
